label: VERIFIED
extraction: Santa Method: multi-agent adversarial verification with dual independent reviewers. Four phases: 1) Generator produces deliverable, 2) Two reviewers (B, C) with context isolation, identical rubric, same inputs, structured JSON output evaluate in parallel, 3) Verdict gate: both must PASS for NICE (ship), otherwise NAUGHTY with merged issues, 4) Fix cycle: fix all critical issues, re-run both reviewers with fresh agents (no memory carryover), max 3 iterations then escalate. Rubric design critical: objective pass/fail per criterion (factual accuracy, hallucination-free, completeness, compliance, internal consistency, technical correctness). Domain extensions for content, code, compliance. Cost ~2-3x generation tokens per cycle. Batch sampling for large batches (10-15%). Metrics: first-pass rate >70%, mean iterations <1.5, issue taxonomy, reviewer agreement %, escape rate 0. Integration: verification-loop first (deterministic), Santa second (semantic); results feed eval metrics; findings become instincts via continuous-learning-v2.
